entries: {first}, a {trait} {job}, moves into {landmark:built} outside {place}, and something there has been waiting.
The roads out of {place} close after {DISASTER:strikes}, and {first}, a {trait} {job}, is not alone in the dark.
{first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, hears {SOMEONE:!plural} call from {landmark} every night at the same hour.
Nobody in {place} will say what happened at {landmark}, and {first}, a {trait} {job}, is hired to clean it.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, digs up {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, and the nights in {place} begin to go wrong.
Each morning {first}, a {trait} {job}, finds {THING:portable} closer to the bed.
{CLOSE:human} comes home from {landmark} changed, and only {first}, a {trait} {job}, can tell.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, must survive {DEADLINE} in {place}, where the {rival} keeps the doors locked from outside.
Snow seals {place}, and {first}, a {trait} {job}, counts more footprints than people in {landmark}.
{MESSAGE:physical} under the door tells {first}, a {trait} {job}: do not open {landmark} again.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, returns to {place} for a funeral, and {SOMEONE:!plural} is still expected at dinner.
The {rival} offers {first}, a {trait} {job}, {PRIZE:material,!inner} to spend one night at {landmark}.
